name: Sheela Foam Ltd
title: Sheela Foam Ltd - 540203 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated core EBITDA margin 11.5% (+400bp) on 24% revenue growth and 15% FY26 volume growth, but no capacity additions tied to demand; supply side is not the story.

capex.quote: We should be somewhere between INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

triggers.label: Smaller foam players exiting supply
triggers.quote: there were smaller players who were finding it difficult to maintain their supply chains. So those orders also got shifted to us.

triggers.label: Raw-material pass-through across channels
triggers.quote: we have been able to pass on the cost increase due to raw material across all the channels, B2C side, the industrial foam side and partly also on the B2B side.

triggers.label: No channel stocking seen
triggers.quote: we don't anticipate any major channel stocking and foam is a very bulky material.

guidance.quote: We should be somewhere between INR125 crores to INR150 crores.
should be around INR140 crores to INR145 crores at a consolidated level.
finance cost should show a figure of around INR50-odd crores
Next year's plan is about INR500 crores, and it's tracking well.
between 30% to 32% would be a stable margin.

red_flags.label: Depreciation policy change flatters profit
red_flags.quote: we have realigned the policy to reflect realistic figures.

red_flags.label: Synergy delay and TDI supply scramble
red_flags.quote: though we had to pay a little more for TDI at a few times during the month

evasions.topic: Pass-through percentage on mattresses and foam
evasions.quote: very difficult to give in percentage terms.
I'll have to get back with these numbers.
